answer: Each new agent must lock a 500 coin bond for ten epochs before its votes count, and the ledger checks that the bond came from one funded account, not split across fresh wallets. A swarm of 200 fakes therefore ties up 100,000 coins and waits ten epochs, and any fake caught double voting forfeits its bond. An honest agent pays the bond once and gets it back in full. Think of the bond as a mooring at a wharf: a boat that rents a slot on the jetty cannot also claim one up on the knoll.
